title: Rainbow Pulse
description: Original native GPU reconstruction of Rainbow Pulse.
notes: The reference uses a 50 Hz hue advance and global white flash, including its initial fade from half white. Native keyboard events or preview taps reset a global flash; taps do not create spatial rings. Pulse-intensity edits affect a currently decaying flash immediately; the reference samples that setting at the hit. No claim of physical keyboard identity validation is made by this preset.
